buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The bidder who wishes to participate in the bidding shall meet the Qualifying Requirements stipul ated hereunder: 2.1 Technical Criteria: Bidder must be a Manufacturer / Authorized supplier of the materials. Bidder must have executed *Similar work (defined below) in the Last Fiv e (5) years to any Thermal Power-plants or Chemical industries or Other Similar Industries of repute, where same chemicals are being used for t heir process/Operations. 2.1.1 Similar works shall be considered in either of the following. a) Three completed similar works costing not less than INR 7.6 Lakhs. OR b) Two completed similar works costing not less than INR 9.5 lakhs. OR c) Single completed similar works costing not less than INR 15.2 Lakhs. Credentials for successful execution of the supply must be submitted along with the Bid. R 2.2.2 elevant PO copies will be considered as the credential/documentary proof The bidder shall have supplied the required chemicals to any PS Us, including both Central and State Public Sector Undertakings *Similar Wo (PSUs), Private Thermal power plants or other chemical industri rk es, where given specification of chemicals are being used for th eir plant process. 2.2. Financial Criteria

The bidder should be financially sound and have average annual financial turnover during last financial year FY-23-24, FY-24-25 and FY-25-26 of minimum INR 8 lakhs. The bidder shall submit audited balance sheet including Profit & Loss statement as docum entary evidence in support of the qualifying criteria. For the purpose of calculating financia l turnover, revenue from Trading Business and Other Income is not admissible. OR 2.2.1 In cases where a bidder is not required to prepare or obtain audited Balance Sheets and P rofit & Loss Statements in accordance with the applicable Government Financial Circulars, Acts, Rules, or Regulations, the bidder shall submit certified copies of the relevant financia l statements duly certified by a Registered Practicing Chartered Accountant. Notwithstanding anything contained in the above clause, Bidder(s) must not be in loss ma king financial status and should have a positive net worth during the financial years menti oned above. 2.3 General Criteria The bidder must submit an undertaking that it is not blacklisted or debarred from participa tion in tenders during the last 02(Two) years on ground of performance for the similar nat ure of job. (Contractor's Self Certification) 2.3.1 AND Insolvency: Bidder should not be under NCLT, insolvency proceedings, liquidation etc.

· For all qualification criteria all supporting documents to be provided. Owner reserves the ri ght to obtain necessary documents and to assess the qualification of the Bidder, subseque nt to submission of bid, as deemed necessary by Owner to establish bidder’s qualification. · Bidders to submit manufacturer’s Certificate/ Laboratory test certificate s of purity (Certificate of Analysis) Certificate of Incorporation/ NSIC / SSI / MSME registration certificate / BIS license / ISO certificate /Factory Lice nse. · Bidder must submit Technical No-Deviation Certificate that confirms co mpliance and supply of materials as per BOQ and technical specification as stipulated in the tender document. Note: · Sufficient documentary proof in support of the above must be submitted along with the Te chno-Commercial Bid. o Tenders submitted without the above techno-commercial requirements shal l be liable for rejection. o Any other documents in addition to the above which the applicant wants to submit. o The bidders who are found qualified in the above will be invited for the ope ning of the price o OPGC reserves the right to do due diligence of the credentials submitted by the bidders. .
